meaning: The catalogue states the part fits this machine model. Interchangeability is NOT implied.
The machine model is built at this plant (catalogue Plant column).
The machine model is of this machine type (catalogue Machine Type column).
Rule-derived: the model-code prefix places the machine in this family. Needs business confirmation.
The machine is sold under this brand / business unit (catalogue Brand / Origin column).
The derived family belongs to this business unit's range.
The plant is owned by this business unit (project brief).
The plant is in this catalogue location (city level).
A city-level location lies in this country-level location.
A rule-derived sub-category (name head) sits under this catalogue category.
The part's catalogue category (level 1, source-stated).
The part's rule-derived sub-category (level 2, name head). Not a taxonomy fact until approved.
The catalogue's Plant of Origin for the part.
The part's previous / legacy part-number record (may be unresolved free text).
The business whose numbering the legacy code belongs to (mostly rule-derived from prefix and plant).
A specification row parsed or copied from the catalogue Spec Note.
Both parts share a name head in the same category. A naming group only: NOT an alternative, NOT interchangeable. Symmetric, stored once (lower id to higher id).
The catalogue mentions the other part as a related component. NOT an alternative, NOT interchangeable.
Synthetic demo co-purchase signal. NOT engineering advice, NOT interchangeable. Symmetric, stored once (lower id to higher id).
A synthetic supplier link for the part (cost, lead time, MOQ, primary flag).
The synthetic backorder is placed with this supplier.
The synthetic backorder is for this part.
The synthetic identification requirement applies to this part.
The identification requirement is for this machine model.
Synthetic: the variant/serial range the requirement lists as acceptable. Does NOT add catalogue fitment.
The synthetic service plan (interval template) is for this machine model. A plan is NOT a service job.
The synthetic service plan uses this part (quantity).
The synthetic warehouse is attached to this plant.
The synthetic placeholder address of the warehouse.
The synthetic placeholder address of the supplier.
The synthetic placeholder address of the dealer.
The synthetic placeholder address of the customer.
The synthetic placeholder address of the (fictional) plant.
The address lies in this synthetic region (VAT rate reference).
Synthetic warehouse stock of the part (on_hand, reserved, available, stock_status). 0 here is an explicit warehouse record.
Synthetic: the dealer is listed as stocking the part (SYN_part_dealer), with its quantities (SYN_inventory).
Synthetic: the dealer serves this machine family. Does NOT mean the dealer supports every model or stocks every part.
The synthetic demo list price of the part (EUR, ex VAT).
The synthetic store profile of the part (status, orderable, weight, warranty...). Kept apart so source facts are never overwritten.
A synthetic compliance record applies to the part.
The synthetic assembly (demo BOM) is sold as this part number.
Synthetic demo BOM: the part is a component of the assembly (quantity).
A synthetic machine specification. Not engineering data.
A synthetic variant / serial range of the machine model.
The synthetic cart belongs to this customer. A cart is NOT a request.
The cart contains this line.
The order contains this line.
The cart line is for this part.
The order line is for this part.
The synthetic order was placed by this customer.
The order's delivery address.
Stock for the line is reserved at, or was shipped from, this warehouse (allocation_status RESERVED or SHIPPED).
The line is NOT yet allocated; this is only its planned fulfilment location.
A step in the order's synthetic status history.
The status the history step records (workflow vocabulary).
The order has this synthetic shipment.
The shipment carries this order line.
The shipment left this warehouse.
The shipment is addressed to this customer.
The (fictional) carrier of the shipment.
A synthetic tracking event of the shipment.
The synthetic delivery estimate starts at this warehouse.
The estimate's destination is this customer.
The estimate's destination is this dealer.
The plant the project brief names as the business unit's home plant.
Synthetic: the supplier's declared category scope. NOT a supply relationship for any specific part (SUPPLIED_BY is the only part-level link).
Synthetic: the compliance requirement's declared category scope. NOT a part-level statement (HAS_COMPLIANCE is).
Synthetic: the warehouse ships to this country. Not a delivery estimate (DeliveryEstimate is).
A synthetic search alias / synonym of the part.
A synthetic search alias of the machine model.
